description: This file defines the MonthViewAdapter class, which is a RecyclerView adapter responsible for displaying a full month calendar view in an Android application. It manages the calendar data, updates the UI for a specific month and year, and contains a nested ViewHolder class for binding views.

classes.name: MonthViewAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView.Adapter subclass that displays a month calendar, manages calendar data, and interacts with nested ViewHolder.

methods.name: updateMonth
methods.description: Updates the calendar display for the specified month and year.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder for the month view.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for a specific position.

attributes.name: calendar
attributes.description: Calendar object set to the current date.

attributes.name: days
attributes.description: List of CalendarDay objects representing each day in the month.

attributes.name: dayAdapter
attributes.description: Adapter for individual day views within the month.

inner_classes.name: MonthViewHolder
inner_classes.description: ViewHolder class for the month view, binds month name and calendar grid.

methods.name: updateMonth
methods.description: Sets calendar to specified month and year, updates days list, and refreshes the display.
